dataset: MFPT (Machinery Failure Prevention Technology) bearing fault dataset, folders 1-4 (three baseline, three outer-race, seven outer-race varying load, seven inner-race varying load)
obtained_via: MathWorks' official redistribution of MFPT folders 1-4: https://github.com/mathworks/RollingElementBearingFaultDiagnosis-Data
units: raw stored acceleration values (g) as distributed; no resampling, filtering, normalisation or truncation applied
citation: Bechhoefer, Eric. 'Condition Based Maintenance Fault Database for Testing Diagnostics and Prognostic Algorithms.' 2013.
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/) per license.txt and README.md in the source zip
provenance_notes: mfpt.org now redirects into the ASNT site and its fault-data-sets page offers only an email contact (datamanagement.ai@mfpt.org), so no direct download from the originating site was available. The MathWorks repo README states it contains folders 1-4 of the original dataset, 're-organized and split into train_folder and test_folder' - i.e. files were regrouped into directories but the .mat contents are the originals. MFPT folders 5 (Analyses) and 6 (Real World Examples) are NOT present in this redistribution.
notes: The FTF value stored in the .mat files (14.8375 Hz) is NOT consistent with the standard cage formula for this geometry, which gives (1/2)(1-d/D)*25 Hz = 10.14 Hz. BPFO, BPFI and BSF are all consistent. The stored FTF is reproduced verbatim in defect_freq_hz without correction; treat it with suspicion.
